rootCause: Circle/ellipse paints always used four cubic approximations despite an already verified native ellipse primitive used for clips. This changed boundaries and dash placement. Native ellipse strokes additionally require their rational-arc contour ruler when applying pathLength.
change: Paint circles/ellipses with capability-checked native ellipse and close the outline; partial failures reset to full prior cubic geometry and disable only that context. Calibrate native ellipse dashes with bounded rational-arc midpoint subdivision following the documented Skia contour-measure geometry. Choose ruler only after actual path construction; fallback and native lengths use separate caches. Analytical length verification is retained.
